title: Our new Newsletter!
body: Due to popular demand we now have a weekly newsletter giving summaries of everything happening in our wonderful church community! Every week this newsletter will be sent out to all of our communications channels and available in print at the back of church on Sunday. Each article will be available in full on our website. You can scan the QR code for the article that interests you or simply visit stjohnspark.org/news on your device to hear the full story. If you would like anything added to the newsletter please talk to one of the leadership team or email hello@saintjohnspark.org.
